question: What division is sought to be known fully and without limit?
premises: A division of eight groups of eight is named
Full knowledge of it is desired
The knowing is to be endless
inference: The division into eight groups of eight is sought to be known fully and endlessly.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean in infinite detail rather than endlessly in time
plain_english: I wish to know fully and endlessly the division into eight groups of eight.
